clips.title: The story
paras: The Maker's Terrace is a sprawling outdoor excavation site situated in the northern Badlands, directly fronting the entrance to the ancient titan vault of Uldaman. Travelers venturing south from Loch Modan must navigate its rugged perimeter, which is aggressively occupied by Dark Iron dwarves. The dig represents a contested threshold between the surface wastes and the titan mysteries entombed below.

Sprawling across the northern bluffs of the Badlands, the Maker's Terrace serves as the exterior staging ground for the subterranean halls of Uldaman. Long before travelers delve into the subterranean ruins, they must contend with the sun-scorched earthworks, scaffolding, and stone trenches of this grand excavation. It sits right along the pass coming down from Loch Modan, making it the first landmark greeting any traveler daring to venture into the arid wastes. The Terrace buzzes with violent industry as rival factions seek a way into the ancient secrets buried beneath the rock.

The site is firmly under the boot of the Dark Iron clan, who patrol its ditches and perimeters with hostile vigilance. Drawn by the scent of titan relics and subterranean dominance, these subterranean dwarves dig incessantly into the hillside, seeking whatever armaments, records, or earthen relics the ancient Makers left behind. Anyone trying to reach the deep halls of Uldaman without clearing through these fortified sentries will quickly find themselves overwhelmed.
